messages:
alex_sales: Heads up — AcmeThera POC wants to finalize the order form. Legal pushed back on DPA subprocessor and HSM clause. Question: can we accept their subproc carveout (they insist on a detailed processor list) or offer standard subproc notification? Also pricing ask: they want committed monthly tokens vs burst — can we do a blended rate for the POC month? cc @kelly_legal @olivia_revops
kelly_legal: Hi Alex — send their redlines pls. On subproc: we can usually agree to notify + list major subprocs (AWS, GCP), but not a detailed vendor list. HSM / KMS: if they need an HSM addendum, that's a Private deployment conversation; not available on hosted tier. @raj_security can advise re: KMS attestations.
olivia_revops: For POC pricing we can do a temporary blended cp with a 30-day review. I'll draft an order form change. Proposed line: `poc_blended_rate: $X per 1M tokens (30d trial)` — we should keep the commitment short.
raj_security: HSM request — we don't support customer-managed HSM on hosted. For DPA subprocessors: standard approach is notice + 30-day objection window. We can provide SOC2 summary and vendor inventory for major subprocs on request. If they ask for contractual consent for each subproc, escalate to GC.
alex_sales: Attaching excerpt from their redline: `Section 5: Subprocessors — must obtain written consent for each subprocessor.` Any quick fallback language?
kelly_legal: Counter language we use: "Customer will be notified of new subprocessors and may object within 30 days on reasonable security/privacy grounds; continuation after the notice period constitutes waiver of objection." If they insist on consent, we involve GC for a carveout; often we can accept a limited consent for specific high-risk vendors.
maria_ps: Also they asked for "single-tenant GPU pool" during POC. That's effectively Dedicated capacity and will change pricing + lead time — flagging infra ops.
olivia_revops: Draft order form uploaded. For signature routing: if ARR > $50k we'll need CRO/Finance exec sign-off. POC estimate falls below that, so standard AE sign + legal countersign should be fine.
contract-bot: New order form draft created by olivia_revops: https://redwood.internal/orderforms/1709004444-prococounter. Review and comment.
david_ops: If they want a dedicated pool, lead time is ~2 weeks for capacity reservation. Also confirm region for data residency.
alex_sales: Thanks — plan: send counter with notice + 30d objection, offer SOC2 + vendor list for major subprocs, propose blended POC rate and a 20% overage for burst. I'll loop in GC if they push consent. :thumbsup:
kelly_legal: Sounds fine. Keep overage math explicit: `overage_rate = committed_rate * 1.2`. Get final numbers from olivia and then we can sign off.
alex_sales: On it, will update customer and post final redline. Appreciate the quick responses!
